integrity: Two exact exhaustive discrete-Morse gradient-DAG checks and complete signed Morse differential matrices with verifiable unimodular integer reductions. All finite verification inputs are included.
limitations: Integral homology only, not a complete homotopy type; no torsion-free conclusion for larger Kneser parameters; no independent audit. Exhaustive integer computations are included for reproduction.
mathematical_scope: Ind(KG(7,3)) in standard Kneser notation; equivalently Ind(KG(3,1)) in Feng-Wang notation and the inclusive symmetric-difference-distance-4 Vietoris-Rips complex of the weight-three layer on seven points.
statement: Complete reduced integral homology of the independence complex of the Kneser graph on all triples of a seven-point set; free ranks 29 in degree 6 and 7 in degree 9, zero otherwise, including no integral torsion.
title: Integral homology of the seven-point triple-intersection complex
